title: Model facility relationships beyond fixed hierarchies
requirements:
- Explain 'multi-axial hierarchy' in plain language
- Rename location hierarchies to relationship types; make each conditional on national policy
- Model administrative/operational trees separately from many-to-many referral and catchment networks
- Offer progressive catchment options with source and confidence
- Harmonise relationship categories across the component
- Represent catchments and population estimates with method, source, date and confidence
